subject: Proposal: Move Nimbus Health to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@hospnimbus.com>, Nimbus Procurement <procurement@hospnimbus.com>, Brian Su <brian.su@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Move Nimbus Health to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the great discussion last week. As promised, I put together a concise plan to move Nimbus from direct invoicing to Azure Marketplace billing and align on the co-sell path with AWS. Goal is to preserve current entitlements and pricing while enabling Nimbus to purchase via your marketplace contract by the upcoming renewal on 2027-09-15.

Key points (high level):
- High-level timeline: intent to cutover billing by 2027-09-01; target final sync before renewal.
- Minimal contract changes: one amendment to route invoicing; we can attach the Marketplace_Amendment_Draft.pdf for legal for review.
- Co-sell motion: coordinate with Brian (AWS) for co-sell registration and publisher enrollment; Redwood will provide required co-sell materials.
- Commercial: we can apply a one-time transition credit to offset any pro-rated double-billing during cutover (details in Pricing_Comparison_Nimbus.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) Nimbus confirms procurement point of contact and any internal purchasing constraints (PO process, SSO requirements).
2) Redwood and AWS stand up a short technical & billing sync (30–45 min) week of Aug 2 to verify SKU mapping and subscription entitlements.
3) Legal teams exchange the single-page amendment for signature (we can use DocuSign).

Attachments: Nimbus_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (timeline & owners), Marketplace_Amendment_Draft.pdf, Pricing_Comparison_Nimbus.xlsx

Would you be available for a quick call on Tue 3 Aug or Wed 4 Aug to align? I can make room on Wed 4 Aug 10:00–10:45 PT.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@hospnimbus.com>

Cc: Nimbus Procurement <procurement@hospnimbus.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Move Nimbus Health to Azure Marketplace billing + co-sell timeline

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few quick clarifying questions from my side and procurement copied in: 

1) Will our existing seat/usage entitlements carry over exactly when we switch billing? We need to avoid any lapse in access for clinical teams.
2) Procurement: our PO process requires a customer-facing invoice and an accounting reference (we use our internal GL codes). Can the marketplace invoice include those references?
3) For co-sell: we work with both AWS and Azure partners. Does moving to Marketplace prevent Redwood from doing direct monthly usage reconciliations with us?

We are generally open to the move; our renewal window is tight so we want to make sure signatures and the billing switch are short. Procurement — any additional constraints on our end?

Thanks,
Elena Torres
VP Product, Nimbus Health
elena.torres@hospnimbus.com

Great questions — thanks. Short answers and next concrete steps below.

1) Entitlements and access: we will preserve the exact entitlement mapping. Redwood's Private/Hosted entitlements are tied to account IDs; for the cutover we will coordinate a staged sync window (no interruption expected). I put the step in row 5 of the Mutual Action Plan.

2) Invoice metadata: Azure Marketplace supports adding a PO/reference field on the invoice if provided at purchase time. For the initial subscription we can pass Nimbus's GL code as the purchase order field so your accounting team sees it. If procurement can share the exact PO format, Marcus will include it in the plan.

3) Usage reconciliation: moving billing to Marketplace does not prevent Redwood from sharing detailed usage reports. We'll provide the same CSV exports and token/usage dashboards. The only change is that billing flows from Azure rather than Redwood's billing system.

Action items:
- Procurement to send PO format and any required W-9/registration info by Mon 2 Aug.
- Brian/AWS: confirm co-sell registration steps — can you take the lead on publisher registration and co-sell packaging?
- Redwood: Marcus will prepare the amendment + DocuSign and I will update the Mutual Action Plan to include the accounting fields.

Proposed meeting: Wed 4 Aug 10:00–10:45 PT — I will send an invite once I hear back on availability.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
